questions: What does 'use with crypto' mean to you here — do you want merchants to *accept* crypto payments from customers, or to *pay out* funds in crypto, or both?
What is the primary audience: developers/merchants who integrate via an API and dashboard, or end-customers making payments directly?
Which cryptocurrencies or networks do you want to support first (e.g., Bitcoin, Ethereum/ERC-20 USDC, Solana, Lightning)? Pick one starting chain.
Do you want a custodial model (your platform holds the crypto) or non-custodial (funds go directly wallet-to-wallet, you just orchestrate and track payments)?
What core features are in scope for v1: one-time payments only, or also subscriptions/recurring billing, invoices, checkout links, webhooks, refunds?
Is this a learning/prototype project or something you intend to run in production (with real money, KYC, compliance)?
Do you have a preferred tech stack (e.g., Node/TypeScript, Python, Rust, Solidity) and frontend (React, Next.js, plain)?
